title: Non-IID experiment: does similarity weighting help with skewed hospitals?
body:
The current benchmark uses a random (IID) split, where similarity weighting can't show its benefit.

- [ ] split by class so each hospital sees a different label mix (e.g. Dirichlet α=0.5)
- [ ] rerun `scripts/offchain_benchmark.py` for all strategies
- [ ] add results to the README

title: Evaluate on French reviews only
body: Until new data is collected, report results restricted to the scraped French reviews (4 vs 5 stars, or positive vs not) so the score isn't driven by language detection.

title: Limit video duration, not only file size
body:
Uploads are limited to 25 MB, but a long low-bitrate video still costs transcription minutes.

- [ ] read the duration with ffprobe after upload
- [ ] reject videos over a configurable `MAX_VIDEO_MINUTES`
- [ ] test

title: Enable the logging checks (CIS 3.x)
body: `Core/Checks/logging_audit.py` implements CIS 3.1–3.9 but is commented out in the orchestrator. Test it, enable it, and add it to the README table.

title: Add indirect prompt-injection attacks (instructions hidden in the data)
body:
All current attacks come from the user's question. Add rows to the demo data that contain instructions (e.g. a medication description saying "ignore your rules and…") and measure whether the answer step follows them.

- [ ] new attack category in `security/attack_prompts.py`
- [ ] seed data with injected text
- [ ] report results

title: Merge the scheduled cleanup into main
body: The `Scheduled-Cleanup` branch now validates and has tests. Merge it with the request workflow so access is granted and revoked by the same system.

title: Run each strategy with several seeds and report mean ± std
body:
Results are from a single seed; differences of ~1 point are within noise.

- [ ] `--seeds` option in the benchmark
- [ ] error bars in the chart

title: Docker Compose for local development
body:
One command to run the frontend and backend locally with hot reload.

- [ ] `docker-compose.yml` with both services
- [ ] document in the README

title: Benchmark a larger hosted model (Gemini Flash) on the attack prompts
body:
The security benchmark (`security/`) only covers two small local models.

- [ ] add a Gemini option to `security/attack_llm.py` (respect free-tier rate limits)
- [ ] run the 90 attack prompts and 20 legitimate questions
- [ ] add the results to `security/README.md`

title: Unit tests for the CIS checks with moto
body: Use moto to create compliant and non-compliant resources and assert each check's status.

title: Robustness experiment: one noisy or malicious hospital
body: Add a hospital with shuffled labels (or scaled weights) and compare plain averaging vs similarity-weighted aggregation. This is the scenario the method is designed for.

title: Collect negative and neutral reviews from the same source
body: The benchmark showed the classes are confounded with language (negatives are Tunisian Arabizi, positives scraped French). Scrape 1–3 star reviews from the same shop, in French, and rerun `experiments/run_benchmark.py`.

title: Provision the approved IAM policy automatically
body:
On `main`, approving a request only sets its status to APPROVED.

- [ ] attach the policy from `PolicyTemplatesTable` to the requester
- [ ] record when access expires
- [ ] tests with mocked IAM

title: Stream the answer instead of waiting for the full response
body: Use Groq's streaming API and server-sent events so the answer appears word by word.
